description: Leggers Waterschap Brabantse Delta is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by DONL Dataregister. In de Legger vindt je informatie over: • sloten en beken (waterlopen) • dijken (waterkeringen), stuwen, sluizen, gemalen en andere (ondersteunende) kunstwerken • wie verantwoordelijk is voor het beheer en onderhoud: zelf, het waterschap of een andere organisatie • de status, ligging, grootte en vorm van wateren, dijken en kunstwerken • de beschermingszones langs waterlopen ... Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher DONL Dataregister. Its tags are Brabantse Delta, Legger, Oppervlaktewaterlichamen, Water, Waterschap. It offers 7 resource(s) in map service. The portal shows 2022-05-12 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
